texts.preamble: C.S. No.968/17 vs New Delhi Municipal Council on 25 August, 2018 In The Court Of Ms.Nupur Gupta, Civil Judgei, New Delhi Judge Code Dl0804 C.S. No.968/17 Unique Case Id No. Devi Ram S/o late Sh. Om Kant Basnit R/o P193, Pilanji Village, Sarojani Nagar, South East Distt. New Delhi110023 Versus New Delhi Municipal Council Palika Kendra, Palika Bhawan, New Delhi110001 Date of Instit Date of Reserving Judgme Date of Judgme Suit For Permanent Injunction Judgment
texts.facts: 1. By filing the present suit, the plaintiff has sought decree of permanent injunction in his favour and against the defendant thereby restraining the defendant, its representatives, assignees, agents, attorneys, associates, nominees etc from interfering in lawful possession of the plaintiff in shop no. 3, Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi110023. (4) Payment of renewal fee sl.no. 025 paid by the plaintiff to the defendant is Ex.PW1/4 (OSR). (5) Payment of renewal fee sl.no. 49 paid by the plaintiff to the defendant is Ex.PW1/5(OSR). (7)Payment of renewal fee sl.no. 014 paid by the plaintiff to the defendant is Ex.PW1/7 (OSR).
texts.arguments: It has been argued by ld. counsel for the plaintiff that the plaintiff has successfully proved his case against the defendant by examining himself as PW1 and relying upon documents Ex.PW1/1 (OSR) to Ex.PW1/20 (OSR), Ex.PW1/22 (OSR), Mark A and Mark B Ex.PW1/G whereby it has been proved that the plaintiff is running the momos stall at Shop no.3 Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi since prior to 2010.
texts.petitioner_arguments: It has been argued by ld. counsel for the plaintiff that the plaintiff has successfully proved his case against the defendant by examining himself as PW1 and relying upon documents Ex.PW1/1 (OSR) to Ex.PW1/20 (OSR), Ex.PW1/22 (OSR), Mark A and Mark B Ex.PW1/G whereby it has been proved that the plaintiff is running the momos stall at Shop no.3 Sarojani Nagar Market, New Delhi since prior to 2010.
